SELECT Level as "Level", A.MENU_ID, A.UPPER_ID, A.NAME, A.DEPTH, A.TYPE, A.URL, A.MENU_ORDER, A.MENU_DC, A.CREATE_DT, A.USE_FLAG, A.ROLE_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO A WHERE 1=1
AND SUBSTR(A.MENU_ID,0,1) = #{st_com_gubun}
AND (A.MENU_ID LIKE '%' || #{st_menu_id} || '%' OR A.UPPER_ID LIKE '%' || #{st_menu_id} || '%' )
AND A.NAME LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{st_menu_name}) || '%'
AND A.URL LIKE '%' || #{st_menu_url} || '%'
AND A.CREATE_DT BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.ROLE_ID IS NULL
AND A.ROLE_ID IS NOT NULL
START WITH DEPTH = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_ID=UPPER_ID
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KX_MENUINFO ( MENU_ID, UPPER_ID, NAME, DEPTH, TYPE, URL, MENU_ORDER, MENU_DC, CREATE_DT, USE_FLAG, ROLE_ID )VALUES ( #{MENU_ID}, #{UPPER_ID}, #{NAME}, #{DEPTH}, #{TYPE}, #{URL}, #{MENU_ORDER}, #{MENU_DC}, TO_DATE(#{CREATE_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD'), #{USE_FLAG}, #{ROLE_ID} )

UPDATE KX_MENUINFO SET NAME = #{NAME}, DEPTH = #{DEPTH}, TYPE = #{TYPE}, URL = #{URL}, MENU_ORDER = #{MENU_ORDER}, MENU_DC = #{MENU_DC}, USE_FLAG = #{USE_FLAG}, ROLE_ID = #{ROLE_ID} WHERE MENU_ID = #{MENU_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT /*selectMasterMdAmMenuManageDetailList*/ A.MENU_ID, A.AUTH_ID, A.USE_FLAG, A.CREATE_DT, B.NAME, B.AUTH_DC FROM KX_MENUAUTH A, KX_AUTHINFO B WHERE A.AUTH_ID = B.AUTH_ID AND A.MENU_ID = #{st_menu_id_detail}
